risk_summary: The disclosure is generally specific and well quantified, including vessel counts, utilization, day rates, segment losses, and a $40.9 million affiliate credit impairment. Risk is elevated due to pandemic-driven contract cancellations, declining revenues and utilization, offshore energy dependence, and concentrated Sonatide/Angola exposure. Standard forward-looking disclaimers and occasional qualitative phrasing modestly limit transparency but do not appear strongly evasive.
